issues.description: Title mixes Czech and English ('Live demonstrace ...'). This is stylistically inconsistent with the rest of the Czech text.
issues.required_fix: Change title to fully Czech (e.g. 'Živé demonstrace a simulace (včetně Minecraft Education)') or make language choice consistent across the document.

issues.description: The recommendation to download and try a free Hour of Code lesson in Minecraft Education appears more than once (in the short summary and in the first practical scenario).
issues.required_fix: Remove the exact duplicate suggestion or merge the occurrences to avoid repetition (keep one clear pointer with the citation kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_04e4a115_page_15_2).

issues.description: The section suggests formative checkpoints and reflection but does not explicitly point readers to the rubric/assessment guidance elsewhere in the manual.
issues.required_fix: Add an explicit cross-reference to the assessment/rubric guidance (chapter on hodnocení/formative assessment) so teachers can align the demo activity with existing rubrics and milestone‑based assessment templates.

issues.description: The LaTeX fragment is generally correct, but it is a standalone body without a section/header command. If this fragment will be inserted into the larger LaTeX document, confirm it is wrapped by an appropriate \section or \subsection and that bibliography keys used by \cite{...} exist in the BibTeX file.
issues.required_fix: Ensure the fragment is enclosed by the correct sectioning command when integrated and verify the cited keys (kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_04e4a115_page_15_2, _page_8_1, _page_51_1) are present in the document bibliography.

suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Replace 'Live demonstrace a simulace (včetně Minecraft Education)' with 'Živé demonstrace a simulace (včetně Minecraft Education)' for consistent Czech wording.

Merge the repeated instruction to 'stáhnout Minecraft Education a vyzkoušet jednu z volně dostupných lekcí Hour of Code' into a single clear recommendation (keep citation \cite{kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_04e4a115_page_15_2}) and remove the duplicate sentence elsewhere.

Add a sentence linking the suggested formative checkpoint to the manual's assessment guidance, e.g.: 'Viz kapitola o hodnocení (rubriky a milestone‑based assessment) pro šablony krátkých formativních check‑pointů a rubriky.' (ensure appropriate internal cross‑reference when integrating).

Consider adding one short example prompt for Designer (e.g. 'vytvoř reklamní banner pro debriefing lekce: styl edukativní infographic, barvy univerzitní palety') to make the suggested live demo more actionable.

Add an explicit pre‑test step: 'Otestujte aktivitu na lokálním zařízení a ověřte, že nevyžaduje síť nebo že máte záložní offline variantu' to reduce risk from network outages (this complements existing 'záložní plán' item).
